result.reason: The New York governing-law language matches the preferred position, but the forum provisions are internally inconsistent: the clause submits the parties to exclusive New York County court jurisdiction while permitting award confirmation in any competent court, including where the losing party resides. Adding a New York arbitral seat also changes the arbitration arrangement beyond the expressly requested court-venue position. The arbitration requirement is otherwise preserved, but the jurisdiction and enforcement language should be reconciled, such as by limiting the exclusivity clause to arbitration-related court proceedings while addressing any necessary enforcement exception.
